transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Enterprise Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex. This is Sandra Smith from Velocity Transportation. I need to add an authorized contact to our corporate account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, I can certainly assist you with that. To ensure the security of your account, I'll first need to verify your credentials. Could you please provide me with your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Of course. It's CUST-2014.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. That's CUST-2014. And for the final verification step, could you please provide the 6-digit security PIN associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, the PIN is 1-6-8-9-8-5.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you for that. Please give me just a moment to pull up your account details... Okay, I see the account for Velocity Transportation is now open. Thank you for your patience, Sandra.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You're welcome.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, you mentioned you'd like to add a new authorized contact. I can definitely process that for you. Who are we adding to the account today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: His name is David Chen. He's our new Operations Manager and will be handling any service-related calls or changes from now on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. David Chen, Operations Manager. I'm noting that down. And just to be clear on the permissions, are you authorizing him to make changes to the service plan, discuss billing, and request technical support?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, all of that. He should have full access to manage the account, short of closing it entirely. That should still require my authorization.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's exactly how our standard authorized contact permissions work. They can perform all account management functions, but only the primary account holder can terminate the service agreement. So that aligns perfectly.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great, that's what we need.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. To proceed, I'll need to gather a little more information for Mr. Chen's profile. Could you spell out his full name for me, please?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure. First name is David, D-A-V-I-D. Last name is Chen, C-H-E-N.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. And what is the best contact phone number for him?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: His direct line is 800-661-8456.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: 800-661-8456. Thank you. I'm adding this to the account record now. It will take me about 30 seconds to get this entered into the system.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem, take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, thank you for waiting. I have created the profile for David Chen as an authorized contact on the account. Now, for the final security step, our system requires an email confirmation from the primary contact.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, what do I need to do?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am sending a secure email right now to the address we have on file for you, which is sandra.smith@velocitytransportation.com. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. I have my email open.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. The email has just been sent from Cymbal Telecom. It will contain a link to approve this change. Once you click that link, David Chen will be officially authorized on the account, and the change will be effective immediately.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I see it. It just came through. I'll click the link as soon as we're off the phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. The link is valid for 24 hours. Once you approve it, he'll be all set. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sandra?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was everything. Thank you for your help, Alex.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome. We appreciate your business. Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Enterprise Support, and have a great rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.
